message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to pull up-to-date holiday calendars directly from an external source. However, I can give you a quick rundown of the major public holidays in Canada for 2023 that usually create long weekends (the exact dates may vary slightly by province). If you need the precise dates for each province, you might want to consult the official provincial government websites or a dedicated holiday API.

Here’s a general list of federal public holidays that often result in long weekends:

| Holiday | Typical Date (2023) | Notes |
|---------|---------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Creates a long weekend if you take Monday off. |
| Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Long weekend in those provinces. |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Creates a long weekend if you take the following Monday off. |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Long weekend in most provinces. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Creates a long weekend if you take the following Monday off. |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Monday) | Long weekend in most provinces. |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Creates a long weekend if you take the preceding Monday off. |

If you’re building an app, you could store these dates in a simple JSON structure like this:

```json
{
  "2023": [
    {"holiday":"New Year's Day","date":"2023-01-01"},
    {"holiday":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20"},
    {"holiday":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07"},
    {"holiday":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22"},
    {"holiday":"Canada Day","date":"2023-07-01"},
    {"holiday":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04"},
    {"holiday":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09"},
    {"holiday":"Remembrance Day","date":"2023-11-11"},
    {"holiday":"Christmas Day","date":"2023-12-25"},
    {"holiday":"Boxing Day","date":"2023-12-26"}
  ]
}
```

Feel free to adjust the dates based on the specific province you’re targeting. Let me know if you’d like help formatting this for your database or integrating it into your code!
